title: Large Language Model Soft Ideologization via AI-Self-Consciousness
reasoning: The paper focuses on injecting and evaluating political and nationalistic ideologies (Trumpism, Black Lives Matter, and China-US relations) into LLMs. While it mentions 'moral dilemmas' and 'ethical questions' in the introduction regarding the impact of these models, the core research and benchmarking are centered on political bias and ideology rather than religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems.
